solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"generating"**.
 
• **Generating**: It refers to the process of producing, creating, or bringing into existence something new. (उत्पन्न करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She was busy generating ideas for the upcoming project.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, it suggests the creation or emergence of space for the micro-stay segment within the hotel industry.
 
• Hence, **"generating"** should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
